verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Codex can package repeatable instructions as skills and run `codex exec` in repeatable workflows. It also has a code review command for commits and branches. None of this documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automations themselves: the review feature covers code changes, not automation definitions, and no history or rollback for automations is described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
